hoa.addon.legacy_item_doesn_t_count_for_.zhCN: 旧版装备：不计入本赛季排行榜。

hoa.addon.legacy_item_doesn_t_count_towa.enUS: Legacy item. Doesn't count toward this season's leaderboard.
hoa.addon.legacy_item_doesn_t_count_towa.zhCN: 旧版装备。不计入本赛季排行榜。

hoa.addon.lets_you_free_look_when_the_ca.enUS: Lets you free look when the camera is on the ground.
hoa.addon.lets_you_free_look_when_the_ca.zhCN: 镜头贴近地面时，允许你自由转动视角。

hoa.addon.level_ups_can_offer_a_new_spel.enUS: Level-ups can offer a new spell while a slot is free.
hoa.addon.level_ups_can_offer_a_new_spel.zhCN: 有空槽时，升级会提供新法术。

hoa.addon.lightens_or_darkens_the_whole_.enUS:
Lightens or darkens the whole picture — nights, caves and interiors are what it is for.

This is the same correction 1.12 applied through the display's own gamma ramp, which it could only do in exclusive fullscreen. benilla applies it to the finished image instead, so it works in both display modes.
hoa.addon.lightens_or_darkens_the_whole_.zhCN:
提亮或压暗整个画面——夜晚、洞穴和室内场景最需要它。

它与 1.12 通过显示器自身的伽马曲线所做的校正相同，只是当年只能在独占全屏下生效。benilla 改为对最终画面进行校正，因此在两种显示模式下都能使用。

hoa.addon.listen_to_sound_from_the_chara.enUS: Listen to sound from the character's point of view rather than the camera.
hoa.addon.listen_to_sound_from_the_chara.zhCN: 以角色而不是镜头的位置来聆听声音。

hoa.addon.lock_the_action_bars_in_place.enUS: Lock the action bars in place.

hoa.addon.locked_cards_stay_through_rest.enUS: Locked cards stay through restocks and return at the same price next visit.
hoa.addon.locked_cards_stay_through_rest.zhCN: 已锁定的卡牌会在补货后保留，并在下次造访时以相同价格再次出现。

hoa.addon.locked_passive_slot.zhCN: 未解锁的被动技能槽位

hoa.addon.look_for_1_run_master_at_the_i.enUS: Look for {1} <Run Master> at the Inn.

hoa.addon.look_for_him_on_the_top_floor_.enUS: Look for him on the top floor of the Inn.

hoa.addon.lower_this_to_see_fewer_of_you.enUS: Lower this to see fewer of your party's spell effects. Your own always show.
hoa.addon.lower_this_to_see_fewer_of_you.zhCN: 调低此项可减少看到的队伍法术特效。你自己的特效始终显示。

hoa.addon.mages_fight_using_staves_sword.enUS: Mages fight using staves, swords, daggers and held items.
hoa.addon.mages_fight_using_staves_sword.zhCN: 法师使用法杖、剑、匕首和副手物品战斗。

hoa.addon.mailed_to_you_when_you_leave.enUS: Mailed to you when you leave

hoa.addon.make_yourself_at_home_friend_t.enUS: Make yourself at home, friend. Tell old Tarn how you like things, and the Inn will keep it that way.
hoa.addon.make_yourself_at_home_friend_t.zhCN: 随意些，朋友。告诉老塔恩你的喜好，旅店会一直照此办理。

hoa.addon.mini_bosses_on_the_last_stage_.enUS: Mini-bosses on the last stage of a run sometimes drop one. It sends 1 piece you found this run home right away, and the run goes on.
hoa.addon.mini_bosses_on_the_last_stage_.zhCN: 远征最后一个阶段的小首领有时会掉落炉石。它可以立即将本次远征中找到的1件装备送回家，远征继续进行。

hoa.addon.more_enemies_come_at_once_they.enUS: More enemies come at once. They drop 25% more gold, and mini-bosses drop gear 50% more often.
hoa.addon.more_enemies_come_at_once_they.zhCN: 同时出现更多敌人。它们掉落的金币多25%，小首领掉落装备的几率提高50%。

hoa.addon.mouse_wheel_zooms_in_and_out.enUS: Mouse wheel zooms in and out.

hoa.addon.named_with_special_powers_call.enUS: Named, with special powers called affixes. The Spellbook Keeper in town lists what each one does.
hoa.addon.named_with_special_powers_call.zhCN: 有名有姓的敌人，带有称为词缀的特殊能力。城里的法术书管理员列出了每种词缀的效果。

hoa.addon.nature_damage_when_the_stacks_.enUS: Nature damage when the stacks discharge.
hoa.addon.nature_damage_when_the_stacks_.zhCN: 层数释放时造成自然伤害。

hoa.addon.no_clears_on_this_level_yet.enUS: No clears on this level yet.
hoa.addon.no_clears_on_this_level_yet.zhCN: 这个级别尚无通关记录。

hoa.addon.no_damage_this_run.zhCN: 本次远征没有造成伤害。

hoa.addon.no_healing_or_absorbs_this_run.enUS: No healing or absorbs this run.
hoa.addon.no_healing_or_absorbs_this_run.zhCN: 本次远征没有治疗或吸收。

hoa.addon.nobody_is_on_this_list_yet.enUS: Nobody is on this list yet.

hoa.addon.not_used_by_your_class.zhCN: 你的职业不使用此槽位。

hoa.addon.nothing_yet_each_hearthstone_s.enUS: Nothing yet. Each Hearthstone sends 1 piece.
hoa.addon.nothing_yet_each_hearthstone_s.zhCN: 目前还没有。每块炉石可以送1件装备。

hoa.addon.offered_after_the_first_timed_.enUS: Offered after the first timed mini-boss and the first two stage bosses, up to 2 per run. Foresight adds one at the start of a run.
hoa.addon.offered_after_the_first_timed_.zhCN: 在第一个限时小首领和前两个阶段首领之后提供，每次远征最多2次。预知会在远征开始时额外增加1次。

hoa.addon.only_appears_on_heroic_and_myt.enUS: Only appears on Heroic and Mythic.
hoa.addon.only_appears_on_heroic_and_myt.zhCN: 仅出现在英雄和史诗难度。

hoa.addon.open_chests_vaults_and_hidden_.enUS: Open chests, vaults and hidden finds
hoa.addon.open_chests_vaults_and_hidden_.zhCN: 打开宝箱、保险库和隐藏发现

hoa.addon.otherwise_it_sells_for_gold_wh.enUS: Otherwise it sells for gold when the run ends.|r
hoa.addon.otherwise_it_sells_for_gold_wh.zhCN: 否则远征结束时它会自动换成金币。|r

hoa.addon.paladins_fight_using_melee_wea.enUS: Paladins fight using melee weapons and shields.
hoa.addon.paladins_fight_using_melee_wea.zhCN: 圣骑士使用近战武器和盾牌战斗。

hoa.addon.pick_a_key_for_it_under_key_bi.enUS: Pick a key for it under Key Bindings, Hordes of Azeroth, Use Hearthstone.
hoa.addon.pick_a_key_for_it_under_key_bi.zhCN: 在按键设置的“艾泽拉斯之潮”分类下，为“使用炉石”设置一个按键。

hoa.addon.plays_a_coin_sound_when_you_co.enUS: Plays a coin sound when you collect experience.
hoa.addon.plays_a_coin_sound_when_you_co.zhCN: 收集经验时播放金币音效。

hoa.addon.prefer_the_classic_player_fram.enUS: Prefer the classic player frame in the top left? Change it under Interface Options, Your Health Bar.
hoa.addon.prefer_the_classic_player_fram.zhCN: 更喜欢左上角的经典玩家头像框？在界面选项的“你的生命条”中更改。

hoa.addon.prefer_the_classic_unit_frame_.enUS: Prefer the classic unit frame in the top left? Under Interface Options, Your Health Bar, you can show your health there instead, or in both places.
hoa.addon.prefer_the_classic_unit_frame_.zhCN: 更喜欢左上角的经典头像框？在界面设置的“你的生命条”里，可以改为在那里显示生命值，或者两处都显示。

hoa.addon.preset_1_click_activate_to_use.enUS: Preset {1}. Click Activate to use these talents.
hoa.addon.preset_1_click_activate_to_use.zhCN: 预设{1}。点击“启用”即可使用这些天赋。

hoa.addon.preset_1_click_set_active_to_u.enUS: Preset {1}. Click Set active to use these talents.
hoa.addon.preset_1_click_set_active_to_u.zhCN: 预设{1}。点击“设为启用”来使用这些天赋。

hoa.addon.press_1_or_click_the_hearthsto.enUS: Press {1} or click the Hearthstone to use it. You can change the key in Key Bindings.
hoa.addon.press_1_or_click_the_hearthsto.zhCN: 按{1}或点击炉石即可使用。可在按键设置中更改按键。

hoa.addon.press_1_to_open_the_pause_menu.enUS: Press {1} to open the pause menu.

hoa.addon.press_cffffd100_1_r_to_toggle_.enUS: Press |cffffd100{1}|r to toggle enemy health bars.
hoa.addon.press_cffffd100_1_r_to_toggle_.zhCN: 按 |cffffd100{1}|r 可切换敌人血条的显示。

hoa.addon.press_cffffffff_1_r_to_2_a_sho.enUS: Press |cffffffff{1}|r to {2} a short way in the direction you're moving. {3}
hoa.addon.press_cffffffff_1_r_to_2_a_sho.zhCN: 按 |cffffffff{1}|r 即可向移动方向{2}一小段距离。{3}

hoa.addon.press_cffffffffescape_r_to_ope.enUS: Press |cffffffffEscape|r to open the pause menu.

hoa.addon.press_the_key_you_want_for_1_e.enUS: Press the key you want for {1}. Escape keeps the current key.
hoa.addon.press_the_key_you_want_for_1_e.zhCN: 按下你想用于{1}的按键。按 Esc 保留当前按键。

hoa.addon.priests_fight_using_maces_stav.enUS: Priests fight using maces, staves and held items.
hoa.addon.priests_fight_using_maces_stav.zhCN: 牧师使用锤、法杖和副手物品战斗。

hoa.addon.pull_1_to_2_a_short_way_in_the.enUS:
Pull {1} to {2} a short way in the direction you're moving. {3}

Try it now!
hoa.addon.pull_1_to_2_a_short_way_in_the.zhCN:
按住{1}即可向移动方向{2}一小段距离。{3}

现在就试试！

hoa.addon.r_to_toggle_enemy_health_bars.zhCN: |r 可切换敌人血条的显示。

hoa.addon.raise_it_if_your_hero_drifts_o.enUS: Raise it if your hero drifts on its own
hoa.addon.raise_it_if_your_hero_drifts_o.zhCN: 如果英雄会自行漂移，请调高此值

hoa.addon.raise_this_if_your_character_m.enUS: Raise this if your character moves on its own.
hoa.addon.raise_this_if_your_character_m.zhCN: 如果你的角色会自行移动，请调高此值。

hoa.addon.refund_1_first_it_depends_on_t.enUS: Refund {1} first. It depends on this one.
hoa.addon.refund_1_first_it_depends_on_t.zhCN: 请先退还{1}。它依赖于此项。

hoa.addon.refund_1_first_it_needs_the_po.enUS: Refund {1} first. It needs the points you spent in {2}.
hoa.addon.refund_1_first_it_needs_the_po.zhCN: 请先退还{1}。它需要你在{2}中投入的点数。

hoa.addon.refund_1_first_it_needs_the_ti.enUS: Refund {1} first. It needs the tickets you spent here.
hoa.addon.refund_1_first_it_needs_the_ti.zhCN: 请先退还{1}。它需要你在此处花费的奖券。

hoa.addon.refunds_all_dark_fortunes_for_.enUS: Refunds all Dark Fortunes for their full Darkmoon Ticket cost.
hoa.addon.refunds_all_dark_fortunes_for_.zhCN: 退还所有黑暗运势，返还全额暗月奖券。

hoa.addon.refunds_all_upgrades_for_their.enUS: Refunds all upgrades for their full gold cost.
hoa.addon.refunds_all_upgrades_for_their.zhCN: 退还所有升级，返还全额金币。

hoa.addon.refunds_every_dark_fortune_you.enUS: Refunds every Dark Fortune you bought. You get all your Darkmoon Tickets back.
hoa.addon.refunds_every_dark_fortune_you.zhCN: 退还你购买的所有黑暗运势。你会取回全部暗月奖券。

hoa.addon.refunds_every_talent_point_you.enUS: Refunds every talent point you spent.
hoa.addon.refunds_every_talent_point_you.zhCN: 退还你消耗的所有天赋点。

hoa.addon.refunds_every_upgrade_you_boug.enUS: Refunds every upgrade you bought. You get all your gold back.
hoa.addon.refunds_every_upgrade_you_boug.zhCN: 退还你购买的所有升级。你会取回全部金币。

hoa.addon.reload_the_interface_to_show_i.enUS: Reload the interface to show it in the new language?
hoa.addon.reload_the_interface_to_show_i.zhCN: 重新载入界面以显示新语言？

hoa.addon.replaces_all_unlocked_cards_ea.enUS: Replaces all unlocked cards. Each restock costs 50% more this visit.
hoa.addon.replaces_all_unlocked_cards_ea.zhCN: 替换所有未锁定的卡牌。本次造访中，每次补货的花费提高50%。

hoa.addon.replaces_every_card_you_haven_.enUS: Replaces every card you haven't locked or bought; bought cards stay sold. Sayge's Restock upgrade sets how many restocks each visit allows. Each restock this visit costs 50% more.
hoa.addon.replaces_every_card_you_haven_.zhCN: 替换所有你未锁定、未购买的卡牌；已购买的保持售出状态。塞格的补货升级决定每次造访可补货几次。本次造访中，每次补货的花费都会提高50%。

hoa.addon.requires_1_darkmoon_tickets_sp.enUS: Requires {1} Darkmoon Tickets spent in the rows above
hoa.addon.requires_1_darkmoon_tickets_sp.zhCN: 需要在上方几行中花费{1}张暗月奖券

hoa.addon.requires_a_connected_talent.zhCN: 需要先学习与其相连的天赋。

hoa.addon.resets_every_run_it_s_not_kept.enUS: Resets every run, it's not kept.
hoa.addon.resets_every_run_it_s_not_kept.zhCN: 每次远征重置，不会保留。

hoa.addon.restocks_skip_a_locked_card_an.enUS: Restocks skip a locked card, and it comes back at the same price on the next visit.
hoa.addon.restocks_skip_a_locked_card_an.zhCN: 补货会跳过已锁定的卡牌，它会在下次造访时以相同价格出现。

hoa.addon.restores_a_portion_of_maximum_.enUS: Restores a portion of maximum health per second.
hoa.addon.restores_a_portion_of_maximum_.zhCN: 每秒恢复一定比例的最大生命值。

hoa.addon.restores_a_share_of_maximum_he.enUS: Restores a share of maximum health every sec.
hoa.addon.restores_a_share_of_maximum_he.zhCN: 每秒恢复一定比例的最大生命值。

hoa.addon.restores_s_of_maximum_health_e.enUS: Restores %s of maximum health every sec.
hoa.addon.restores_s_of_maximum_health_e.zhCN: 每秒恢复%s的最大生命值。

hoa.addon.restores_s_of_maximum_health_p.enUS: Restores %s of maximum health per second.
hoa.addon.restores_s_of_maximum_health_p.zhCN: 每秒恢复%s的最大生命值。

hoa.addon.rewards_1_x_gold_darkmoon_tick.enUS: Rewards {1}x gold, Darkmoon Tickets and Mastery experience.
hoa.addon.rewards_1_x_gold_darkmoon_tick.zhCN: 奖励{1}倍金币、暗月奖券和专精经验值。

hoa.addon.rewards_1_x_tickets_and_master.zhCN: 奖励{1}倍奖券和专精经验

hoa.addon.right_click_an_item_to_buy_it_.enUS: Right-click an item to buy it, Ctrl-click to preview it. Right-click your own items to sell them.
hoa.addon.right_click_an_item_to_buy_it_.zhCN: 右键点击物品购买，Ctrl+点击预览。右键点击你自己的物品出售。

hoa.addon.right_click_to_ban_it_from_you.enUS: Right-click to ban it from your runs.
hoa.addon.right_click_to_ban_it_from_you.zhCN: 右键点击将其从远征中禁用。

hoa.addon.right_click_to_upgrade_to_ilvl.enUS: Right-click to upgrade to ilvl {1} for {2} Scrap.
hoa.addon.right_click_to_upgrade_to_ilvl.zhCN: 右键点击，花费{2}废料升级至物品等级{1}。

hoa.addon.right_click_to_upgrade_to_item.enUS: Right-click to upgrade to item level {1} for {2} Scrap.
hoa.addon.right_click_to_upgrade_to_item.zhCN: 右键点击即可升级至物品等级{1}，花费{2}废料。

hoa.addon.right_stick_cursor_in_blizzard.enUS: Right stick cursor in Blizzard windows
hoa.addon.right_stick_cursor_in_blizzard.zhCN: 在暴雪原生窗口中用右摇杆控制光标

hoa.addon.rogues_fight_using_melee_weapo.zhCN: 盗贼使用近战武器战斗。

hoa.addon.runs_as_a_1_earn_mastery_exper.enUS: Runs as a {1} earn Mastery experience for every minute you survive and every mini-boss and stage boss you kill. Harder difficulties earn more.
hoa.addon.runs_as_a_1_earn_mastery_exper.zhCN: 以{1}身份进行的远征，每存活一分钟、每击杀一个小首领和阶段首领，都会获得专精经验值。难度越高，获得越多。

hoa.addon.s_can_choose_it_as_their_start.enUS: %s can choose it as their starter spell at the Run Master.
hoa.addon.s_can_choose_it_as_their_start.zhCN: %s可以在远征大师处选择它作为起手法术。

hoa.addon.sayge_sells_it_once_you_finish.enUS: Sayge sells it once you finish the quest "{1}" (complete {2} quests).
hoa.addon.sayge_sells_it_once_you_finish.zhCN: 完成任务“{1}”后，塞格就会出售它（需完成{2}个任务）。

hoa.addon.sayge_sells_rank_1_once_you_ha.enUS: Sayge sells rank {1} once you have completed {2} quests.
hoa.addon.sayge_sells_rank_1_once_you_ha.zhCN: 完成{2}个任务后，塞格会出售第{1}级。

hoa.addon.scrolls_combat_text_towards_th.enUS: Scrolls combat text towards the bottom of the screen.
hoa.addon.scrolls_combat_text_towards_th.zhCN: 战斗信息向屏幕下方滚动。

hoa.addon.scrolls_combat_text_towards_th.enUS: Scrolls combat text towards the top of the screen.
hoa.addon.scrolls_combat_text_towards_th.zhCN: 战斗信息向屏幕上方滚动。

hoa.addon.scrolls_the_text_in_arcs_away_.enUS: Scrolls the text in arcs away from the player.
hoa.addon.scrolls_the_text_in_arcs_away_.zhCN: 战斗信息沿弧线从玩家身边向外滚动。

hoa.addon.season_1_mythic_clears_with_ge.enUS: Season {1}. Mythic clears with gear found this season. Ties go to the faster clear.
hoa.addon.season_1_mythic_clears_with_ge.zhCN: 第{1}赛季。使用本赛季找到的装备取得的史诗通关。成绩相同时，用时更短者排名更高。

hoa.addon.select_a_highlighted_action_th.enUS: Select a highlighted action, then press the button you want for it
hoa.addon.select_a_highlighted_action_th.zhCN: 选择一个高亮的操作，然后按下你想为它设定的按钮

hoa.addon.select_an_action_then_press_a_.enUS: Select an action, then press a button to bind it.
hoa.addon.select_an_action_then_press_a_.zhCN: 选择一个操作，然后按下要绑定的按钮。

hoa.addon.sells_for_1_and_gives_2_scrap_.enUS: Sells for {1} and gives {2} Scrap if you leave it out of the vault.
hoa.addon.sells_for_1_and_gives_2_scrap_.zhCN: 如果不放进保险库，可卖出{1}并获得{2}废料。

hoa.addon.sells_for_1_if_you_leave_it_ou.enUS: Sells for {1} if you leave it out of the vault.
hoa.addon.sells_for_1_if_you_leave_it_ou.zhCN: 如果不放进保险库，可卖出{1}。

hoa.addon.sends_1_piece_home_now_you_los.enUS: Sends 1 piece home now. You lose it for the rest of the run.
hoa.addon.sends_1_piece_home_now_you_los.zhCN: 立即将1件装备送回家。本次远征剩余时间内你将失去它。

hoa.addon.set_the_camera_to_always_prefe.enUS: Set the camera to always prefer being behind your character.
hoa.addon.set_the_camera_to_always_prefe.zhCN: 镜头始终倾向于位于你的角色身后。

hoa.addon.set_the_camera_to_be_above_wat.enUS: Set the camera to be above water when your character is above water, and below water when your character is below water.
hoa.addon.set_the_camera_to_be_above_wat.zhCN: 角色在水面上时，镜头保持在水面之上；角色在水面下时，镜头则位于水面之下。

hoa.addon.set_the_camera_to_stay_where_p.enUS: Set the camera to stay where placed, except when your character is moving.
hoa.addon.set_the_camera_to_stay_where_p.zhCN: 镜头保持在你放置的位置，除非你的角色正在移动。

hoa.addon.set_the_camera_to_stay_where_p.enUS: Set the camera to stay where placed, except when your character is moving.  (Recommended Mode)
hoa.addon.set_the_camera_to_stay_where_p.zhCN: 镜头保持在你放置的位置，除非你的角色正在移动。（推荐模式）

hoa.addon.set_the_camera_to_stay_where_s.enUS: Set the camera to stay where set, and never auto-adjust.
hoa.addon.set_the_camera_to_stay_where_s.zhCN: 镜头保持在设定的位置，不会自动调整。

hoa.addon.sets_the_camera_to_always_be_a.enUS: Sets the camera to always be aligned with your character when changing direction with click-to-move.
hoa.addon.sets_the_camera_to_always_be_a.zhCN: 使用点击移动改变方向时，镜头始终与你的角色保持对齐。

hoa.addon.sets_the_camera_to_follow_your.enUS: Sets the camera to follow your character after a brief delay when changing direction with click-to-move. (Recommended Mode)
hoa.addon.sets_the_camera_to_follow_your.zhCN: 使用点击移动改变方向时，镜头会在短暂延迟后跟随你的角色。（推荐模式）

hoa.addon.sets_the_camera_to_follow_your.enUS: Sets the camera to follow your character after a brief delay when changing direction with click-to-move. (Recommended Mode)
hoa.addon.sets_the_camera_to_follow_your.zhCN: 使用点击移动改变方向时，镜头会在短暂延迟后跟随你的角色。（推荐模式）

hoa.addon.sets_the_camera_to_not_move_wh.enUS: Sets the camera to not move when changing direction with click-to-move.
hoa.addon.sets_the_camera_to_not_move_wh.zhCN: 使用点击移动改变方向时，镜头不会移动。

hoa.addon.sets_the_direction_that_combat.enUS: Sets the direction that combat text scrolls.
hoa.addon.sets_the_direction_that_combat.zhCN: 设置战斗信息滚动的方向。

hoa.addon.shades_the_whole_area_inside_t.enUS: Shades the whole area inside the range ring, not just its edge.
hoa.addon.shades_the_whole_area_inside_t.zhCN: 为范围环内的整个区域着色，而不只是边缘。

hoa.addon.shadow_damage_over_time_that_g.enUS: Shadow damage over time that grows.
hoa.addon.shadow_damage_over_time_that_g.zhCN: 不断增长的持续暗影伤害。

hoa.addon.shamans_fight_using_melee_weap.enUS: Shamans fight using melee weapons and shields.
hoa.addon.shamans_fight_using_melee_weap.zhCN: 萨满祭司使用近战武器和盾牌战斗。

hoa.addon.shared_by_your_group_stand_nex.enUS: Shared by your group. Stand next to a downed teammate to revive them.
hoa.addon.shared_by_your_group_stand_nex.zhCN: 由你的队伍共享。站在倒地的队友身旁即可复活他们。

hoa.addon.shared_by_your_party_stand_nea.enUS: Shared by your party. Stand near a fallen ally to revive them.
hoa.addon.shared_by_your_party_stand_nea.zhCN: 由你的队伍共享。站在倒地的队友身旁即可复活他们。

hoa.addon.shield_is_restored_after_4_sec.enUS: Shield is restored after 4 sec without taking damage.
hoa.addon.shield_is_restored_after_4_sec.zhCN: 4秒内未受到伤害后，护盾会恢复。

hoa.addon.show_damage_caused_by_your_pet.enUS: Show damage caused by your pet.
hoa.addon.show_damage_caused_by_your_pet.zhCN: 显示你的宠物造成的伤害。

hoa.addon.show_low_mana_and_health.zhCN: 显示低法力值和生命值

hoa.addon.show_my_characters_on_the_lead.enUS: Show my characters on the leaderboard
hoa.addon.show_my_characters_on_the_lead.zhCN: 在排行榜上显示我的角色

hoa.addon.show_reactive_spells_and_abili.zhCN: 显示可触发法术和技能

hoa.addon.show_the_bottom_left_action_ba.enUS: Show the bottom left action bar.

hoa.addon.show_the_bottom_right_action_b.enUS: Show the bottom right action bar.

hoa.addon.show_the_second_right_action_b.enUS: Show the second right action bar.
hoa.addon.show_the_second_right_action_b.zhCN: 显示第二条右侧动作条。

hoa.addon.show_your_characters_on_the_pu.enUS: Show your characters on the public leaderboard? Your solo and group Mythic clears are sent with the character's name and class. You can change this any time at the bottom of this window.
hoa.addon.show_your_characters_on_the_pu.zhCN: 是否在公开排行榜上显示你的角色？你的单人和组队史诗通关记录会连同角色名称和职业一起发送。你可以随时在此窗口底部更改。

hoa.addon.shown_under_an_enemy_s_bar_wit.enUS: Shown under an enemy's bar with their stacks. On a boss's bar, each icon wipes away as its time runs out unless you hit the boss again.
hoa.addon.shown_under_an_enemy_s_bar_wit.zhCN: 显示在敌人血条下方，并标明层数。在首领血条上，每个图标会随时间流逝而消退，除非你再次攻击首领。

hoa.addon.shown_under_an_enemy_s_health_.enUS: Shown under an enemy's health bar with their stacks. On bosses, hitting again refreshes each icon before it runs out.
hoa.addon.shown_under_an_enemy_s_health_.zhCN: 显示在敌人的血条下方，并标明层数。在首领身上，再次攻击会在每个图标消失前刷新它。

hoa.addon.shows_a_message_when_an_aura_f.enUS: Shows a message when an aura fades from the player.
hoa.addon.shows_a_message_when_an_aura_f.zhCN: 当光环从你身上消失时显示提示信息。

hoa.addon.shows_a_message_when_the_playe.enUS: Shows a message when the player gains an aura.
hoa.addon.shows_a_message_when_the_playe.zhCN: 当你获得光环时显示提示信息。

hoa.addon.shows_a_message_when_you_enter.enUS: Shows a message when you enter or leave combat.
hoa.addon.shows_a_message_when_you_enter.zhCN: 进入或离开战斗时显示提示信息。

hoa.addon.shows_a_message_when_you_fall_.enUS: Shows a message when you fall below 20% mana or health.
hoa.addon.shows_a_message_when_you_fall_.zhCN: 当你的法力值或生命值低于20%时显示提示信息。

hoa.addon.shows_attacks_against_you_that.enUS: Shows attacks against you that dodge, parry, or miss.
hoa.addon.shows_attacks_against_you_that.zhCN: 显示针对你的攻击被躲闪、被招架或未命中的情况。

hoa.addon.shows_health_bars_over_enemies.enUS: Shows health bars over enemies near you.
hoa.addon.shows_health_bars_over_enemies.zhCN: 在附近的敌人上方显示血条。

hoa.addon.shows_health_bars_over_your_pa.enUS: Shows health bars over your party members during a run. They're always hidden in town.
hoa.addon.shows_health_bars_over_your_pa.zhCN: 在远征期间于队友头顶显示生命条。在城镇中始终隐藏。

hoa.addon.shows_how_much_damage_each_of_.enUS: Shows how much damage each of your spells has done this run.
hoa.addon.shows_how_much_damage_each_of_.zhCN: 显示本次远征中你的每个法术造成了多少伤害。

hoa.addon.shows_the_damage_you_take_as_n.enUS: Shows the damage you take as numbers beside your character.
hoa.addon.shows_the_damage_you_take_as_n.zhCN: 以数字形式在你的角色旁显示你受到的伤害。

hoa.addon.shows_the_hordes_of_azeroth_ti.enUS: Shows the Hordes of Azeroth tips again from the start.
hoa.addon.shows_the_hordes_of_azeroth_ti.zhCN: 从头重新显示艾泽拉斯之潮的提示。

hoa.addon.shows_the_ring_around_you_for_.enUS: Shows the ring around you for {1} seconds.
hoa.addon.shows_the_ring_around_you_for_.zhCN: 在你周围显示范围环，持续{1}秒。

hoa.addon.shows_the_seconds_left_on_spel.enUS: Shows the seconds left on spells with a cooldown of 2 seconds or more.
hoa.addon.shows_the_seconds_left_on_spel.zhCN: 显示冷却时间在2秒及以上的法术的剩余秒数。

hoa.addon.shows_when_you_resist_taking_d.enUS: Shows when you resist taking damage from attacks or spells.
hoa.addon.shows_when_you_resist_taking_d.zhCN: 显示你抵抗了攻击或法术伤害的情况。

hoa.addon.shows_your_health_as_numbers_o.enUS: Shows your health as numbers on your health bars.
hoa.addon.shows_your_health_as_numbers_o.zhCN: 以数字形式在血条上显示你的生命值。

hoa.addon.simulate_head_bobbing_when_in_.enUS: Simulate head bobbing when in first-person perspective.
hoa.addon.simulate_head_bobbing_when_in_.zhCN: 第一人称视角下模拟头部晃动。

hoa.addon.size_of_reward_cards_when_paus.enUS: Size of reward cards when Pause on Rewards is disabled.
hoa.addon.size_of_reward_cards_when_paus.zhCN: 关闭“奖励时暂停”后，奖励卡片的大小。

hoa.addon.slowed_by_1_return_to_your_par.enUS: Slowed by {1}%. Return to your party.
hoa.addon.slowed_by_1_return_to_your_par.zhCN: 移动速度降低{1}%。请回到队伍身边。

hoa.addon.sometimes_dropped_by_mini_boss.enUS: Sometimes dropped by mini-bosses on a run's last stage. Sends one piece of gear found this run home without ending the run.
hoa.addon.sometimes_dropped_by_mini_boss.zhCN: 有时由远征最后一个阶段的小首领掉落。可将本次远征找到的一件装备送回家，且不会结束远征。

hoa.addon.spend_them_with_sayge_at_the_i.enUS: Spend them with Sayge at the Inn.

hoa.addon.spent_at_the_darkmoon_vendors_.enUS: Spent at the Darkmoon vendors. You keep them between runs.
hoa.addon.spent_at_the_darkmoon_vendors_.zhCN: 在暗月商人处消费。远征结束后保留。

hoa.addon.spent_during_a_run_to_open_che.enUS: Spent during a run to open chests and buy from shops. Resets every run, it's not kept.
hoa.addon.spent_during_a_run_to_open_che.zhCN: 在远征中用于开启宝箱和在商店购物。每次远征都会重置，不会保留。

hoa.addon.spent_on_chests_and_shops_duri.enUS: Spent on chests and shops during a run. Lost when the run ends.
hoa.addon.spent_on_chests_and_shops_duri.zhCN: 在远征中用于开箱和商店购物。远征结束时丢失。

hoa.addon.spent_on_chests_and_shops_duri.enUS: Spent on chests and shops during the run.
hoa.addon.spent_on_chests_and_shops_duri.zhCN: 在远征中用于开箱和商店购物。

hoa.addon.spent_on_gear_and_upgrades_at_.enUS: Spent on gear and upgrades at the Inn. Kept between runs.
hoa.addon.spent_on_gear_and_upgrades_at_.zhCN: 在旅店用于购买装备和升级。远征结束后保留。

hoa.addon.stage_1_takes_you_to_any_1_zon.enUS: Stage 1 takes you to any {1} zone.
hoa.addon.stage_1_takes_you_to_any_1_zon.zhCN: 第1阶段会带你前往任意{1}区域。

hoa.addon.steam_deck_controls_connected.zhCN: 已连接 Steam Deck 控制器

hoa.addon.step_into_the_moonwell_to_heal.enUS: Step into the Moonwell to heal (
Step into the Moonwell to heal ({1}s)
hoa.addon.step_into_the_moonwell_to_heal.zhCN: 站入月亮井即可治疗（{1}秒）

hoa.addon.switches_to_the_talents_saved_.enUS: Switches to the talents saved in the selected preset. Your current talents stay in their preset.
hoa.addon.switches_to_the_talents_saved_.zhCN: 切换到所选预设中保存的天赋。你当前的天赋会保留在原来的预设中。

hoa.addon.switches_to_this_preset_s_tale.enUS: Switches to this preset's talents. Your current talents stay saved.
hoa.addon.switches_to_this_preset_s_tale.zhCN: 切换到此预设的天赋。你当前的天赋仍会保存。

hoa.addon.synchronize_the_frame_rate_wit.enUS: Synchronize the frame rate with the monitor's refresh rate.
hoa.addon.synchronize_the_frame_rate_wit.zhCN: 将帧率与显示器刷新率同步。

hoa.addon.talent_points_come_from_master.enUS: Talent points come from Mastery levels. Right-click to refund one.
hoa.addon.talent_points_come_from_master.zhCN: 天赋点来自专精等级。右键点击可退还一点。

hoa.addon.talents_can_only_be_changed_at.enUS: Talents can only be changed at the Inn.

hoa.addon.talk_to_1_the_innkeeper_he_kee.enUS: Talk to {1}, the Innkeeper. He keeps your settings: the interact key and what it works on, chests that open by themselves, where your health bar sits and more.
hoa.addon.talk_to_1_the_innkeeper_he_kee.zhCN: 与旅店老板{1}交谈。他管理你的设置：交互键及其作用对象、自动开启的宝箱、生命条的位置等。

hoa.addon.talk_to_1_the_innkeeper_to_cha.enUS: Talk to {1}, the Innkeeper, to change settings such as the interact key, auto-opening chests and your health bar position.
hoa.addon.talk_to_1_the_innkeeper_to_cha.zhCN: 与旅店老板{1}交谈，可更改交互键、自动打开宝箱、生命条位置等设置。

hoa.addon.talk_to_1_the_run_master_he_le.enUS: Talk to {1}, the Run Master. He lets you pick a map and starts your first run.
hoa.addon.talk_to_1_the_run_master_he_le.zhCN: 与远征大师{1}交谈。他让你挑选地图，并开始你的第一次远征。

hoa.addon.teleport_a_short_distance_in_t.enUS: Teleport a short distance in the direction you're moving. In midair, you teleport the way you're facing.
hoa.addon.teleport_a_short_distance_in_t.zhCN: 朝你移动的方向传送一小段距离。在空中时，则朝你面朝的方向传送。

hoa.addon.teleports_you_a_short_distance.enUS: Teleports you a short distance in the direction you're moving, or forward while in midair.
hoa.addon.teleports_you_a_short_distance.zhCN: 朝你移动的方向传送一小段距离，在空中时则向前传送。

hoa.addon.the_controller_page_in_the_pau.enUS: The Controller page in the pause menu shows what every button does. You can also change the camera speed, the stick deadzone and the button prompts there.
hoa.addon.the_controller_page_in_the_pau.zhCN: 暂停菜单中的控制器页面显示了每个按键的功能。你还可以在那里调整镜头速度、摇杆死区和按键提示。

hoa.addon.the_darkmoon_deck_table_at_the.enUS: The Darkmoon Deck table at the foot of the stairs shows every Darkmoon Card and Glyph you own.
hoa.addon.the_darkmoon_deck_table_at_the.zhCN: 楼梯脚下的暗月套牌桌会展示你拥有的所有暗月卡片和雕文。

hoa.addon.the_darkmoon_deck_table_at_the.enUS: The Darkmoon Deck table at the foot of the stairs shows every Darkmoon Card and Glyph you own. Ban the ones you don't want to see in your runs.
hoa.addon.the_darkmoon_deck_table_at_the.zhCN: 楼梯脚下的暗月套牌桌会展示你拥有的所有暗月卡片和雕文。禁用你不想在远征中看到的那些。

hoa.addon.the_gold_you_bring_back_is_you.enUS: The gold you bring back is yours to keep. Upstairs, Nix Sparkwrench sells upgrades that last through every run.
hoa.addon.the_gold_you_bring_back_is_you.zhCN: 你带回的金币归你所有。楼上，尼克斯·火花扳手出售对所有远征生效的升级。

hoa.addon.the_last_stage_has_a_summoning.enUS: The last stage has a Summoning Stone.
hoa.addon.the_last_stage_has_a_summoning.zhCN: 最后一个阶段有召唤石。

hoa.addon.the_launcher_downloads_the_lea.enUS: The launcher downloads the leaderboard when it starts.
hoa.addon.the_launcher_downloads_the_lea.zhCN: 启动器会在启动时下载排行榜。

hoa.addon.the_level_you_play_sets_the_ti.enUS: The level you play sets the tier of the gear it drops, and the quality of each piece is rolled.
hoa.addon.the_level_you_play_sets_the_ti.zhCN: 你所玩的级别决定其掉落装备的阶级，每件装备的品质则是随机决定的。

hoa.addon.the_rest_sell_for_1_and_give_2.enUS: The rest sell for {1} and give {2} Scrap.
hoa.addon.the_rest_sell_for_1_and_give_2.zhCN: 其余的可卖出{1}，并获得{2}废料。

hoa.addon.the_run_goes_on_if_you_re_outs.enUS: The run goes on. If you're outside the ring when it fills, the Hearthstone fades.
hoa.addon.the_run_goes_on_if_you_re_outs.zhCN: 远征继续进行。如果法环填满时你不在其中，炉石就会消散。

hoa.addon.the_run_is_paused_while_you_ch.enUS: The run is paused while you choose.

hoa.addon.there_are_no_objectives_right_.enUS: There are no objectives right now.

hoa.addon.there_is_no_map_for_this_place.enUS: There is no map for this place.

hoa.addon.this_endless_mode_gives_no_ext.enUS: This endless mode gives no extra rewards, a proper endless mode is coming later. Enemies and bosses keep coming, and they spawn faster and faster until you fall. Your time and score are saved as your best finale.
hoa.addon.this_endless_mode_gives_no_ext.zhCN: 该无尽模式不会提供额外奖励，正式的无尽模式将在以后推出。敌人和首领会源源不断地出现，并且出现得越来越快，直到你倒下。你的时间和得分会作为最佳终章记录保存。

hoa.addon.this_ends_your_run_gear_in_you.enUS: This ends your run. Gear in your Extraction Vault waits in your mailbox; everything else you found is sold for gold.
hoa.addon.this_ends_your_run_gear_in_you.zhCN: 这将结束你的远征。提取保险库中的装备会在邮箱里等你；你找到的其他东西都会换成金币。

hoa.addon.this_ends_your_run_your_extrac.enUS: This ends your run. Your Extraction Vault is empty, so everything you found will be sold for gold.
hoa.addon.this_ends_your_run_your_extrac.zhCN: 这将结束你的远征。你的提取保险库是空的，所以你找到的所有东西都会换成金币。

hoa.addon.this_piece_has_had_all_its_upg.enUS: This piece has had all its upgrades.
hoa.addon.this_piece_has_had_all_its_upg.zhCN: 这件装备已用完所有升级。

hoa.addon.this_run_counts_for_the_leader.enUS: This run counts for the leaderboard.

hoa.addon.this_run_won_t_count_for_the_l.enUS: This run won't count for the leaderboard because {1} is above {2}.
hoa.addon.this_run_won_t_count_for_the_l.zhCN: 本次远征不计入排行榜，因为{1}高于{2}。

hoa.addon.this_run_won_t_count_for_the_l.enUS: This run won't count for the leaderboard because {1} is legacy gear.
hoa.addon.this_run_won_t_count_for_the_l.zhCN: 本次远征不计入排行榜，因为{1}是旧版装备。

hoa.addon.toggle_text_counters_for_buff_.enUS: Toggle text counters for buff durations on and off.
hoa.addon.toggle_text_counters_for_buff_.zhCN: 开启或关闭增益持续时间的文字计时。

hoa.addon.toggles_emote_sounds_on_and_of.enUS: Toggles emote sounds on and off.

hoa.addon.try_it_now_you_can_change_the_.enUS: Try it now! You can change the key under Key Bindings.
hoa.addon.try_it_now_you_can_change_the_.zhCN: 现在就试试！你可以在按键设置中更改按键。

hoa.addon.turn_enemy_health_bars_on_and_.enUS: Turn enemy health bars on and off under Key Bindings.
hoa.addon.turn_enemy_health_bars_on_and_.zhCN: 在按键设置中可以开关敌人血条。

hoa.addon.turn_on_the_box_below_to_be_li.enUS: Turn on the box below to be listed.
hoa.addon.turn_on_the_box_below_to_be_li.zhCN: 勾选下方的选项即可上榜。

hoa.addon.uncheck_this_box_to_hide_your_.enUS: Uncheck this box to hide your character's cloak.
hoa.addon.uncheck_this_box_to_hide_your_.zhCN: 取消勾选此项可隐藏你角色的披风。

hoa.addon.uncheck_this_box_to_hide_your_.enUS: Uncheck this box to hide your character's helm.
hoa.addon.uncheck_this_box_to_hide_your_.zhCN: 取消勾选此项可隐藏你角色的头盔。

hoa.addon.up_to_1_passives_per_run.zhCN: 每次远征最多{1}个被动技能。

hoa.addon.upgrades_apply_to_all_your_cha.enUS: Upgrades apply to all your characters. Right-click to refund a rank.
